Account_AccountAuth_Tip: Sign in with email (one-time code, no password) to use community features.
Account_AccountChangeEmail_Tip: Send a confirmation link to a new address. The current address keeps working until you confirm the new one.
Account_AccountChangeUsername_Tip: Pick a new username. Checked against the community for uniqueness.
Account_AccountDelete_Tip: Permanently remove your account. Presets you uploaded stay available for people who downloaded them but lose your name. Your cloud backup is deleted too.
Account_AccountDetailsWhatSStoredWhyAnd: : what's stored, why, and how to remove it.
Account_AccountExport_Tip: Save a JSON file with the data your account holds: email, profile, uploads, votes, car-fact submissions, download history, sign-in sessions, linked accounts, supporter status, reports you have filed, and any moderation notices.
Account_AccountSessionsRefresh_Tip: Re-check which devices are signed in to your account.
Account_AccountSessionsRevokingSignsTheO: Revoking signs the other device out within a few minutes while it's running. A device that's offline or asleep signs out the next time it comes online.
Account_AccountSignOutOthers_Tip: Revoke every other device's session. This device stays signed in.
Account_AccountStatus: Not signed in. Sign in to use community features.
Account_AccountUsername: Sign in to claim a username.
Account_DiscordLinkStatusLinkFailed: Couldn't link Discord. Check your connection and try again.
Account_DiscordLinkStatusNotLinked: Joins you to the community Discord and links your account, so your contributions earn roles.
Account_DiscordLinkStatusSignInFirst: Sign in first, then join Discord.
Account_DiscordLinkStatusUnlinkFailed: Couldn't unlink Discord. Check your connection and try again.
Account_LinkDiscordLinked_Tip: You're a member of the community Discord. Wooo!
Account_LinkDiscordNotLinked_Tip: You're not a member of the community Discord yet. Click to join.
Account_LinkDiscordSignedOut_Tip: Sign in first, then you can join the community Discord.
Account_LinkDiscord_Tip: Opens Discord in your browser to link your account and add you to the Trueforce For All community server, where your contributions earn roles.
Account_LinkPatreon_Tip: Unlock the supporter badge and cloud backup from your Patreon pledge. If your Patreon has Discord connected and you're already in the community server, it links Discord too.
Account_PatreonLinkStatusLinkFailed: Couldn't link Patreon. Check your connection and try again.
Account_PatreonLinkStatusNotLinked: Link Patreon to unlock the supporter badge and cloud backup from your pledge.
Account_PatreonLinkStatusSignInFirst: Sign in first, then link Patreon.
Account_PatreonLinkStatusUnlinkFailed: Couldn't unlink Patreon. Check your connection and try again.
Account_UnlinkDiscord_Tip: Remove the link between your TF4ALL account and your Discord account.
Account_UnlinkPatreon_Tip: Remove the link between your TF4ALL account and your Patreon account.
Controls_ControlsTabHostAutoForce_Tip: Runs the current game's auto force calibration: iRacing sets the max force from the learned peak, Forza re-levels the auto strength.
Controls_ControlsTabHostBindWheelOrButto: Bind wheel or button-box controls to adjust things while you drive, without opening this panel. Click a field below, then press the button you want to use. Master gain stays between 0 and 2.
Controls_ControlsTabHostStepPerPress_Tip: How far master gain moves on each press of the bound buttons below.
Controls_ControlsTabHostTheseActionsAlso: These actions also appear in SimHub's Controls and events list. Bindings are stored by SimHub, not in your TF4ALL preset.
PresetManager_CarACarCanHaveSeveral: A car can have several presets; the ★ in Default marks the one that loads for that car.
PresetManager_CarClearDefault_Tip: Remove this car's default preset so it falls back to the game preset instead.
PresetManager_CarEdit_Tip: Open this car preset on the Effects tab to change its values. Saving over a built-in makes a copy.
PresetManager_CarListEmpty: No car-specific presets yet. Load a car in a game, tune an effect section, and use Save for this car on the Effects tab.
PresetManager_CarPromoteBuiltin_Tip: DEV: promote this car preset to a factory built-in. It gets the 'Built-in' badge and its file moves to the factory folder. Pick one row or check several to bulk-promote.
PresetManager_CarRename_Tip: Rename this preset (e.g. 'Wet setup' to 'Endurance'). To rename the CAR instead, use the Name box in Car facts on the active card.
PresetManager_CarSearch_Tip: Type to narrow the list by car ID or preset name. Composes with the game chips above.
PresetManager_CarSelectAll_Tip: Check / uncheck every visible car preset.
PresetManager_CarSetActive_Tip: Make this the preset that loads for this car by default. With multiple rows checked, sets each as its own car's default (one per car; it won't apply if two rows target the same car).
PresetManager_CarShare_Tip: Upload this car preset to the community so other drivers can find it.
PresetManager_CommunityCarNoneCar: (none - load a car in the game first)
PresetManager_CommunityDelete_Tip: Soft-delete one of your own uploads. Visible only on rows you uploaded while signed in.
PresetManager_CommunityDownload_Tip: Opens a preview of what's inside; pick which parts to import, then confirm.
PresetManager_CommunityEdit_Tip: Edit one of your own uploads (name, description, body) without resetting its votes and downloads. Visible only on rows you uploaded while signed in.
PresetManager_CommunityEmptyCar: No presets shared for this car yet.
PresetManager_CommunityEmptyGame: No presets shared for this game yet.
PresetManager_CommunityFixAppeal_Tip: This upload was removed or suspended. Fix it and request a moderator review.
PresetManager_CommunityHelp: Browse and download community presets for the car you're driving.
PresetManager_CommunityHelpCarUnscoped: No car loaded, so showing every car preset the community has shared. Load a car in your game and refresh to filter.
PresetManager_CommunityHelpEngine: Browse and download community custom engines (cylinder patterns + layout).
PresetManager_CommunityHelpGame: Browse and download community game presets for the game you're playing.
PresetManager_CommunityHelpGameUnscoped: No game loaded, so showing every game preset the community has shared. Load a game and refresh to filter.
PresetManager_CommunityHelpMine: Your community uploads. Select a row to reveal Edit and Delete.
PresetManager_CommunityHelpPack: Browse and download community packs (bundles of game presets, car presets, and custom engines).
PresetManager_CommunityReport_Tip: Flag inappropriate content for moderator review.
PresetManager_CommunitySearchClear_Tip: Clear the search and go back to the car you're driving.
PresetManager_CommunitySearch_Tip: Find presets by name, author, or car name (e.g. type 'mx5') across the games selected below. Clear to go back to the car you're driving.
PresetManager_CommunityShowMore_Tip: Load the next page of community results.
PresetManager_CustomEnginesYouVeCreated: Engines you've created. Built-in layouts (V8, Rotary, etc.) aren't listed.
PresetManager_CustomListEmpty: No custom engines yet. Create one from the Engine pulse section on the Effects tab (drop-down > New custom engine).
PresetManager_CustomSearch_Tip: Type to narrow the list by engine name.
PresetManager_CustomSelectAll_Tip: Check / uncheck every visible custom engine.
PresetManager_CustomShareNew_Tip: Upload this custom engine to the community.
PresetManager_CustomShare_Tip: Upload this custom engine to the community so other drivers can find it.
PresetManager_DevBarOpenFolder_Tip: Open the built-in preset folder in Explorer.
PresetManager_DevBarRefreshLibrary_Tip: Re-scan the factory + user folders and rebuild every runtime cache. Use after editing files in the folders outside the app (imports, manual edits).
PresetManager_DevBarValidate_Tip: Parse every built-in and flag any that fail to load or are missing a newer effect section.
PresetManager_DevModeBannerDeveloperMode: Developer mode is active. Type DEV again in Settings to turn it off.
PresetManager_EmptyShareCta_Tip: Share your local preset so other drivers can find it for this scope.
PresetManager_Export_Tip: Pick which presets and car tunings to bundle into a shareable file. Same flow as the Export button on the main panel.
PresetManager_GameEdit_Tip: Open this preset for editing on the Effects tab, with an Editing banner. Edit and save the usual way; Done returns you to your previously-active preset (saving over a built-in makes a copy).
PresetManager_GameListEmpty: No game presets yet. Save your tuning as a preset from the Effects tab to start a library.
PresetManager_GamePromoteBuiltin_Tip: DEV: promote this preset to a factory built-in. It gets the 'Built-in' badge and its file moves to the factory folder. Pick one row or check several to bulk-promote.
PresetManager_GameSearch_Tip: Type to narrow the list by preset name. Cleared automatically when the tab reloads.
PresetManager_GameSelectAPresetToSee: Select a preset to see what it contains. Built-ins can't be renamed or deleted; saving over one makes a copy.
PresetManager_GameSelectAll_Tip: Check / uncheck every visible game preset.
PresetManager_GameSetDefault_Tip: Check the games this preset should auto-load for. Uncheck to drop a game's binding.
PresetManager_GameShare_Tip: Upload this game preset to the community so other drivers can find it.
PresetManager_Import_Tip: Import a preset, car preset, pack, or full settings backup. The file kind is auto-detected.
PresetManager_InstalledPacks_Tip: View installed community packs. Set a pack's contents as defaults in bulk, or remove a pack (deletes its presets; entries you have edited are kept).
PresetManager_ModeCommunity_Tip: Browse presets shared by other drivers.
PresetManager_ModeLibrary_Tip: Presets saved on this machine (yours plus anything downloaded from the community).
PresetManager_ModeUploads_Tip: Presets you've uploaded. Select a row to edit or delete your upload.
PresetManager_PacksAPackBundlesSeveral: A pack bundles several presets at once. Find shared packs in the Community view.
PresetManager_PacksCreate_Tip: Bundle game presets, car presets, and custom engines from your library into a pack and upload it to the community.
PresetManager_PacksRemove_Tip: Delete every preset this pack installed that you haven't edited. User-edited entries are preserved.
PresetManager_PacksSetDefaults_Tip: Bind every preset this pack ships as the auto-load default for the games / cars it targets.
PresetManager_RefreshLibrary_Tip: Refresh. In a Library view, reloads presets from disk (use after dropping JSON files into the library folders). When browsing Community or My uploads, re-fetches the latest list from the server.
PresetManager_ShareBuiltin_Tip: Built-in presets ship with the plugin. Duplicate it to make your own version, then share that.
PresetManager_ShareCommunitySourced_Tip: Shared by another driver. Duplicate to make your own version and share that.
PresetManager_ShareMatchesUpload_Tip_Fmt: This matches your last upload ({0}). Edit it to share an update.
PresetManager_SharePack_Tip_Fmt: Bundle these {0} presets into a community pack.
PresetManager_ShareUpdateOrNew_Tip: Update your last upload or share as new (click to choose).
PresetManager_UpdatesChip_Tip: One or more community presets you downloaded have a newer version. Click to review them.
Resources_EffectRevertDiscardUnsavedChan: Discard unsaved changes (revert to the active preset's saved values).
Resources_EffectSaveUnsavedChangesClickT: Unsaved changes. Click to save (per-car or to preset).
Resources_NewEffectBadgeAddedInARecentUp: Added in a recent update. Disappears once you expand the section or change a value.
Support_NotIntoChippingIn: Not into chipping in? Sharing the project helps just as much.
Support_SupportKofi_Tip: One-off tip via Ko-fi, no account needed.
Support_SupportPatreon_Tip: Recurring support on Patreon (patreon.com/Mhytee). Also unlocks cloud backup and sync.
Support_SupportShareDialog_Tip: Post on X, Reddit, or Facebook, or copy the GitHub / Nexus link.
Support_SupportersWallEmpty: Be the first to support Trueforce For All.
Support_SupportersWallError: Couldn't load supporters. Check your connection and try again.
Support_SupportersWallGated: Turn on community features (Settings tab) to load the supporters wall.
Support_ThePeopleKeepingThe: The people keeping the lights on. Thank you.
Support_TheseOpenInYourBrowser: These open in your browser. Patreon is recurring and unlocks cloud backup/sync; Ko-fi and PayPal are one-off tips.
Support_TrueforceForAllIs: Trueforce For All is free for everyone, forever. If it has brought your wheel to life in a game that never had Trueforce, you can chip in to help cover the servers and the time that keep it growing. Supporting on Patreon also gets you cloud backup and sync, and a spot on the wall below.
